citation_title: When Behavioral Recovery Conceals Organizational Change
author: Hongju Liu
release_status: Not decided by this ledger; consult current release records.

inspection_scope: Final paper, current receipts/module, preceding novelty memo and versioned independent review inspected. Neither experiment rerun here. This is not a full inherited-map semantic audit.

condition_sets.P: Section 3: finite positive pair-context law; source sees T; reader sees X; one feedback B=g(X) from <=L labels precedes one reply Z=f(T,B) from <=K labels; decoder sees X,B,Z; no uncounted current input or transcript distinctions. Randomness, if used, satisfies COINS.
condition_sets.COINS: All private/public random tapes independent of current (T,X). Correlated state is additional side information.
condition_sets.MATCH: Section 5.1: same uniform external (T,J) in [6]x[3], fixed graph-specific 3-regular neighbor routers; only T reaches source and only candidate pair reaches reader.
condition_sets.ACTUAL: Independently admitted actual comparison tokens, interval, router/ports/timing, true access boundaries, physically supported policy class, and one invariant capability contract J.

claims.claim: A common commuting prediction has maximum TV error at least D/2.
conditions: Separate product-component updates; same preparation, clock and observer.
proof_evidence: Triangle inequality; explicit changed-readout continuation example.
claims.non_extrapolation: A null order effect proves neither independence nor source/subject count.

claims.claim: All traces through depth m agree; a depth m+1 trace separates.
conditions: Fixed zero reset, flag-setting actions and conditional C; m>=1.
proof_evidence: Before any short-trace C, at most m-1 flags were set.
claims.non_extrapolation: Presetting flags changes the experiment; no universal finite-identification impossibility.

claims.claim: Exact compensation-target recovery iff ker(H) is contained in ker(AM); minimum exact monitor dimension rank(AM).
conditions: Fixed linear model; d,u unrestricted; freely designed exact linear monitors for dimension claim.
proof_evidence: Factorization AM=LH and indistinguishable kernel witness.
claims.non_extrapolation: Real monitor dimension is neither bit budget nor experience amount.

claims.claim: Bounded-correction target set has minimax radius sqrt(rho^2-||H^+z||^2)||AM(I-H^+H)||_2.
conditions: Feasible exact z; Euclidean ||u||<=rho; d unrestricted.
proof_evidence: Orthogonal kernel decomposition; antipodal extremes; central estimator.
claims.non_extrapolation: Additional constraints on d can shrink the set; causal baseline meaning needs justification.

claims.claim: Controlled-interface equivalence preserves observed laws for every adaptive finite-history policy.
conditions: Related initial states; matching readouts; relation preserved by every allowed command; suitable stochastic coupling.
proof_evidence: Induction on policy histories.
claims.non_extrapolation: Cannot infer occurrence multiplicity or pre-intervention subject count.

claims.claim: Sharp decoder-aware top-K recovery need not be attained by a source-only installed helper.
proof_evidence: Both G_2=1; prism optimum 8/9; EXACT_RESULTS check deliberate_context_access_countercontrol.
claims.non_extrapolation: Does not retract the ideal bound or imply all blind sources fail.

claims.claim: S*=1-W+Cut_(K^L)(G,w), with w_e the smaller endpoint joint mass; deterministic attainment.
conditions: K,L positive integers; L counts symbols, not bits.
proof_evidence: Equal response words incur w_e; differing-coordinate selector attains the bound; EXACT_RESULTS check weighted_complete_protocol_vs_cut.
claims.non_extrapolation: New project application of classical machinery; not arbitrary-interaction, quantum or asymptotic theory.

claims.claim: Independent private/public randomness cannot improve average optimum.
proof_evidence: Condition all tapes; input law unchanged; average deterministic bounds.
claims.non_extrapolation: Correlated pre-shared task state is not free randomness.

claims.claim: Zero error iff chi(G)<=K^L; K=1 leaves success 1-W.
conditions: Every supported endpoint mass positive; logarithmic label formula only for K>=2.
proof_evidence: Positive edge losses vanish exactly under proper coloring.
claims.non_extrapolation: K^L counts response words, not target symbols transmitted per reply.

claims.claim: Complete-graph value equals equation (11), attained by balanced classes.
conditions: Uniform complete graph; n>=2; C=min(n,K^L), n=Cq+r.
proof_evidence: Balancing decreases within-class pairs; EXACT_RESULTS check complete_graph_balanced_formula.
claims.non_extrapolation: Not a new asymptotic coding rate or an experience scale.

claims.claim: The six-state organizations match the listed marginals, posterior spectra and isolated ideal scores.
proof_evidence: Eighteen oriented-edge counts; EXACT_RESULTS check common_external_input_law.
claims.non_extrapolation: Full joint laws and internal routers differ; graph is not physical wiring.

claims.claim: Best one-bit source-only success is 1 for K3,3 and 8/9 for the prism.
proof_evidence: Bipartition; two triangles force two uncut edges; seven-edge cut attained; EXACT_RESULTS no-feedback enumerations.
claims.non_extrapolation: Average optimum, not each-context accuracy, a learner limitation or experience ratio.

claims.claim: One timely feedback bit plus one reply bit attains perfect recovery; three forward symbols also suffice.
proof_evidence: Coloring (0,1,2,1,2,0), words 00/01/10 and distinguishing coordinate; receipt attainment checks.
claims.non_extrapolation: Added route changes the assembly; feedback is not an experience gate.

claims.claim: Feedback after the scored reply is fixed retains the source-only prism ceiling 8/9.
conditions: K=2; irrevocable reply; no later target-dependent modulation.
proof_evidence: Effective pre-reply L=1; PROCESS_RESULTS late_feedback event ordering.
claims.non_extrapolation: Logical order does not estimate biological or hardware milliseconds.

claims.claim: Final exact run reports 51 records and 38,013 enumerated candidate tables.
conditions: Current receipt and checker hashes above.
proof_evidence: EXACT_RESULTS record_count/enumerated_candidate_tables; direct protocol cells on small weighted instances.
claims.non_extrapolation: Larger checks reuse reduction; counts do not prove theorem or enumerate random strategies.

claims.claim: Executed reference has 126 trials, 252 workers; prism 16/18 blind/late and 18/18 timely.
conditions: Inspected fixed functions; explicit pipes; eighteen external stimuli per mode.
proof_evidence: PROCESS_RESULTS summary/trials and recorded code hash.
claims.non_extrapolation: No OS security, all-program causal isolation, biological latency or phenomenality certification.

claims.claim: The separate two-coordinate common-role block decodes 48 cases; mixed roles can fail.
conditions: One fixed reader role across block: A, B, or A XOR B; specified binary matrix M.
proof_evidence: M and I+M invertible; EXACT_RESULTS records 49 and 50.
claims.non_extrapolation: Not unrestricted iid batching or a demonstrated repair of the prism protocol.

claims.claim: Excess recovery rejects a conjunction of law/access/alphabet/timing/protocol/measurement assumptions.
conditions: Declared bound is applicable to the tested contract; comparison measurement justified.
proof_evidence: Logical contrapositive of conditional optimum; explicit alternative premise violations.
claims.non_extrapolation: No unique hidden wire, occurrence/subject count, or free remote-source access.

claims.claim: A genuinely different common-J capability implies different complete experiential types only through inherited C:P1.
conditions: UCT C1/C:P1 admitted; proven score gap is truly J(s)!=J(t).
proof_evidence: Inherited conditional implication; finite benchmark supplies no independent actual grounding.
claims.non_extrapolation: No empirical UCT validation, named feeling, intensity, threshold or exclusive owner; local persistence retained.

conditions: Recovered baseline and effective R175 G-implies-A restriction.
proof_evidence: Frozen paper reports effective-record correction; release patch must be verified separately.
